svg.title: IRDAS parallel specialist training with task arithmetic merge
svg.desc: Four-phase pipeline: DR teacher used as init, parallel HR and vessel specialist training, task arithmetic merge, joint calibration into final multi-task model with three heads

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What is the DR teacher architecture in IRDAS?')
sendPrompt('How should I train the HR specialist in IRDAS?')
sendPrompt('How should I train the vessel specialist in IRDAS?')
sendPrompt('Explain task arithmetic and how to implement it for IRDAS')
sendPrompt('How should I run joint calibration in IRDAS phase 4?')
sendPrompt('Explain the DR CORAL head in IRDAS')
sendPrompt('Explain the HR classification head in IRDAS')
sendPrompt('Explain the vessel segmentation head in IRDAS')
sendPrompt('What is the expected performance of the final IRDAS multi-task model?')
